questions.question: How large is Nue when summoned by Sukuna?
questions.subject: Nue

answer.item: When summoned by Sukuna after he incarnated through Megumi, Nue is gargantuan in size, being large enough to perch on top of a skyscraper.

questions.question: How is the shadowgraphy required to summon Nue formed?
questions.subject: Nue

answer.item: The shadowgraphy required to summon Nue is formed when the user claps their hands together to imitate the shape of wings.

questions.question: What kind of creature was the nue originally conceived as?
questions.subject: Nue

answer.item: Capable of flight (often in the form of a black cloud), it was originally conceived of as a kind of nocturnal "monster bird" that made eerie bird cries resembling a White's thrush's
